ns2:section.sectionText: Section title: Advances in Functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging Description: Advanced imaging methods to study brain function, such as ultra high field (7T) MRI, are playing an increasingly large role in cognitive science. In this course, we will discuss a variety of advanced MRI methods, and their application to questions in cognitive science. Prerequisites: familiarity with MRI and brain function; the following courses or their equivalent: PSYC 204, PSYC 220, PSYC 404/NEUR 405, PSYC 445.
